title: Reduce payment retry limit to prevent request lockups
text: Changed retry_limit from 10 to 3. The payment provider began throttling requests after repeated failures. Limiting retries reduced long waits and prevented a single checkout from blocking the request worker.
author: Maya Chen

title: PR #142: Make payment retries bounded
text: Discussion: We saw checkout requests remain open while the provider returned repeated 429 responses. The team agreed to cap retries at 3 and use exponential backoff. This keeps the user request bounded and makes failures visible to the caller.
author: Payments team

title: Issue #88: Checkout hangs after repeated payment failures
text: Users reported checkout spinning for a long time when the payment API was unavailable or rate limited. Investigation traced the delay to repeated retries with no effective upper bound.
author: Support

title: Add cache invalidation after profile update
text: Clear the profile cache after a successful profile write. Previously the API returned stale profile data until the cache TTL expired.
author: Arjun Rao

title: Issue #103: Updated profile still shows old values
text: A user can save a new display name, but the profile endpoint sometimes returns the old value. The database write succeeds; the cached response is not refreshed.
author: QA
